Set flextable defaults from a brand.yml file

Source: R/brand_flextable.R
set_flextable_brand_defaults.Rd

set_flextable_brand_defaults() sets flextable::set_flextable_defaults() from a brand.yml file, so tables created with flextable match the Table style in a reference document created with brand_reference_docx(). flextable formats each table directly (rather than using the reference document's Table style), so the defaults are needed for tables to match.

Usage

set_flextable_brand_defaults(brand = NULL, theme_fun = NULL, ...)

Arguments

brand

Path to a brand.yml file or a directory containing one, a brand_yml object from brand.yml::read_brand_yml(), or a list with the brand settings (e.g. from yaml12::read_yaml()). If NULL (default), the path is taken from the BRAND_YML_PATH environment variable or, if that is not set, found by searching the working directory and its parent directories for _brand.yml or _brand.yaml, either directly or in a brand or _brand subdirectory (the same search used by Quarto and brand.yml::read_brand_yml()).

theme_fun

A flextable theme function applied to each new table, before the header settings. Defaults to flextable::theme_box() (borders on every cell, as in the reference document Table style).

...

Additional arguments passed to flextable::set_flextable_defaults(). These take precedence over the brand settings.

Value

The previous flextable defaults, invisibly. Pass them to do.call(flextable::set_flextable_defaults, old) to restore them.

Details

The following brand.yml settings are used:

  • typography.base: family, size, and line-height (if unitless) for the table text.

  • color.foreground for the text color.

  • defaults.docx.styles.Table: border-color, border-width, cell-padding, and header (family, size, weight, style, color, and background-color for the header row).

Examples

if (rlang::is_installed(c("flextable", "yaml12"))) {
  brand_path <- system.file("extdata", "_brand.yml", package = "officerExtras")

  old <- set_flextable_brand_defaults(brand_path)
  flextable::flextable(head(mtcars, 3))

  do.call(flextable::set_flextable_defaults, old)
}
